Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human erythroleukemia cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HEL92.1.7 cells, an erythroblast-like erythroleukemia model derived from a male patient with acute erythroid leukemia and useful for hematopoietic, erythroid, and leukemia regulatory programs.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from cultured suspension leukemia cells: nuclei are collected from the pooled cell population and accessible DNA is tagmented in situ with Tn5 transposase prior to library amplification.
